title: Flat workspace shell with a panel plugin host and per-reply usage
description: The inspector becomes a panel plugin host with Context, Files and Costs plugins and a Split / Full size switch; full size docks the conversation beside the panel. Agent replies read as full-width turns, user messages as bubbles, the run state as a pill. Each reply's cost marker shows the model and its tokens; the conversation header shows turns, tokens and cache share beside the session cost.
